name: Umezawa Mirei Kristy
original_name: 梅澤 美玲 クリスティー
source:
Area: Kyoto

A half-Japanese, half-French girl who has exceptional skills at flower arranging, but is also quite sheltered due to her parents' way of raising her. Kristy is very polite and uses honorifics with everyone, though she also has a weird habit of adding English words into her sentences.

Her colorful and lively flower arrangements reveal her pure heart, and her hair looks like it has never been cut.
